name: 4XVR Video Player
summary: High-precision VR cinema player engineered for ultra-high-bitrate 8K 180/360 stereoscopic clips, ISO/3D Blu-ray, and SMB NAS streaming.
ranking_rationale: Crystal-clear native stereoscopic decoding and SMB/DLNA local network streaming; weighed against paid pro unlock (~$30) needed past short trial playback.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Crystal-clear native stereoscopic decoding and SMB/DLNA local network streaming
Zero account telemetry required for standalone Meta Quest & PICO playback
cons: Paid Pro unlock (~$30) needed past short trial playback
No built-in online store discovery like DeoVR
